_comment: Pinned stories shown above the live Substack feed in #writing. Newest first. Use this for pieces published off the Hinge & Near Field feed (Medium, The Daily Whatever Show). Remove an entry when it's no longer timely; an empty list hides the block.

stories.title: Something About the Irkutsk Plague Story Doesn’t Add Up
stories.excerpt: A lab tech at an anti-plague institute who didn’t take the antibiotics. A sealed hospital. A Kremlin that won’t say the word. The more we learn, the stranger it gets.

stories.title: The Fed Is Hitting the Brakes. AI Is Flooring the Gas.
stories.excerpt: Big Tech is borrowing hundreds of billions to win the AI race and taking whatever price the market gives it. Everyone else gets the bill.

stories.title: Russia’s Anti-Plague Lab Had a Plague. Then Officials Refused to Say “Plague.”
stories.excerpt: A 28-year-old lab assistant broke a tube of live bacteria and died. 197 contacts, a sealed hospital, and not one official willing to say the word.

stories.title: Trump Made a 13-Year-Old Be His Own Lawyer. It’s Exactly as F@#ked Up as It Sounds.
stories.excerpt: No lawyer, two bad choices, and a deportation order for a kid who told the judge, “I have no one.”
